conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: Private collection, California, purchase, after 1946; The artist, exchange, 1956; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY, 1969; Françoise and Harvey Rambach, Locust, New Jersey, 1985; Owings-Dewey Fine Art, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Sid Deutsch Gallery, New York, NY, exchange, 1986; Private collection, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1990; (Richard York Gallery, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . [notes backing inscription 1]. Lake with dark mountain background. Green trees foreground. Lake deep blue." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks note inscription 1 and indicate, "Note: Possible in 1926 exhibition, for which we have no catalogue, and painted 1925. O'Keeffe thinks 1925 or 1926." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1926. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1926. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Exchanged in 1956 by . . . for yellow tree" [see cat. no. 1153]. Exchanged in 1986 for cat. no. 949. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Lake George – Blue

description: Yellowish-green trees line the shore in front of an expanse of vibrant blue water. On the other shore, dark hills stretch out beneath a clouded sky with hints of blue.
